documents.text:
LEASE (fictional)

This Lease is dated 1 June 2026 and made between Thornbury Estates Ltd (the "Landlord") and Lyle & Grant LLP (the "Tenant").

1. Term
1.1 The term of this Lease is fifteen (15) years from and including 24 June 2026.

2. Rent
2.1 The Tenant shall pay the rent by equal quarterly payments in advance on the usual quarter days.
2.2 The rent shall be reviewed on 24 June 2031 and every fifth anniversary after that.

3. Repair and decoration
3.1 The Tenant shall redecorate the interior of the Premises in the last year of the term.
3.2 The Tenant shall carry out any repairs specified in a notice from the Landlord within two (2) months after receiving it.

4. Alienation
4.1 The Tenant shall not assign the whole of the Premises without the Landlord's consent, which is not to be unreasonably withheld.

MASTER SUPPLY AGREEMENT (fictional)

This Agreement is effective as of February 1, 2026 (the "Effective Date") between Kestrel Parts Co. ("Supplier") and Ardent Robotics, Inc. ("Buyer").

1. Term
1.1 This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and expires on January 31, 2029.

2. Forecasts and orders
2.1 Buyer shall provide a rolling six-month forecast no later than the tenth (10th) day of each calendar month.
2.2 Supplier shall acknowledge each purchase order within two (2) business days following receipt.

3. Quality
3.1 Buyer shall inspect the goods within fifteen (15) days following delivery and notify Supplier of any defects.

4. Termination
4.1 Either party may terminate this Agreement upon ninety (90) days' prior written notice to the other party.
4.2 Upon expiration or termination, Buyer shall pay for all goods delivered within thirty (30) days following the invoice date.
